tools.name: aeep_list_capabilities
tools.description: List semantic capabilities and their available CLI, Python, HTTP, MCP, or host executors before choosing an action.

tools.name: aeep_route_action
tools.description: Profile and rank feasible execution routes for an agent action without executing it. Returns estimates, hard-constraint rejections, score components, and the selected route.

capability.description: Stable semantic action name, for example text.stats or github.issue.create.

input.description: JSON input passed to the selected executor.

policy.description: Routing policy name: balanced, cheapest, fastest, resource_saver, reliable, or a manifest policy.

constraints.description: Optional hard budget, latency, compute, privacy, and safety constraints.

context.description: Optional current quota/capacity, state-locality, sensitivity, and trace context.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key that prevents duplicate execution of the same action.

tools.name: aeep_execute_action
tools.description: Route and execute an agent action within the operator-configured server approval ceiling. AEEP applies hard constraints first, then balances cost, latency, compute pressure, reliability, quality, and risk. Returns execution receipts.

capability.description: Stable semantic action name, for example text.stats or github.issue.create.

input.description: JSON input passed to the selected executor.

policy.description: Routing policy name: balanced, cheapest, fastest, resource_saver, reliable, or a manifest policy.

constraints.description: Optional hard budget, latency, compute, privacy, and safety constraints.

context.description: Optional current quota/capacity, state-locality, sensitivity, and trace context.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key that prevents duplicate execution of the same action.

dry_run.description: Return the route decision without invoking the executor.

tools.name: aeep_record_outcome
tools.description: Report the observed result of a browser, computer-use, model, or other host-delegated route so future decisions learn its actual cost, latency, compute use, and reliability.

QuotaState.description: Private opportunity-cost signal for a non-transferable subscription.
QuotaState.title: QuotaState

ResourceVector.description:
Raw resource dimensions for one attempt.

`memory_mb_seconds` is the integral of route-attributable resident memory
over time. `peak_memory_mb` is retained separately because it is useful as a
hard capacity constraint rather than only a consumable-resource signal.

subscription_units.description: Provider-local capacity units; not cash and not transferable.
subscription_units.title: Subscription Units

ResourceVector.title: ResourceVector

tools.name: aeep_estimate_route_prices
tools.description: Read non-binding price estimates derived from local route data. This operation is non-binding and performs no remote quote network calls.

capability.description: Stable semantic action name, for example text.stats or github.issue.create.

input.description: JSON input passed to the selected executor.

policy.description: Routing policy name: balanced, cheapest, fastest, resource_saver, reliable, or a manifest policy.

constraints.description: Optional hard budget, latency, compute, privacy, and safety constraints.

context.description: Optional current quota/capacity, state-locality, sensitivity, and trace context.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key that prevents duplicate execution of the same action.

tools.name: aeep_request_quotes
tools.description: Deprecated alias for aeep_estimate_route_prices. Returns local, non-binding estimates and performs no remote quote network calls.

capability.description: Stable semantic action name, for example text.stats or github.issue.create.

input.description: JSON input passed to the selected executor.

policy.description: Routing policy name: balanced, cheapest, fastest, resource_saver, reliable, or a manifest policy.

constraints.description: Optional hard budget, latency, compute, privacy, and safety constraints.

context.description: Optional current quota/capacity, state-locality, sensitivity, and trace context.

tools.name: aeep_get_metrics
tools.description: Read private aggregate savings, substitutions, resource use, and subscription capacity conserved from local AEEP history.

tools.name: aeep_show_prepared_decision
tools.description: Read a persisted, sanitized prepared-route decision. This never prepares or executes a route and never contacts a quote provider.

tools.name: aeep_show_quote
tools.description: Read a persisted, sanitized bounded quote, including its evidence level, maximum amount, expiry, and signature metadata.

tools.name: aeep_show_settlement
tools.description: Read a persisted, sanitized settlement receipt, including reserved, captured, and released amounts and its evidence level.

tools.name: aeep_discover_resources
tools.description: Search operator-configured sources using public terms only. Returns inert untrusted metadata; never installs, qualifies, activates or assesses a resource.

tools.name: aeep_lookup_capability
tools.description: Look up local, scoped evidence for an inspected candidate. Returns an applicable admission or a reason to assess or keep the current environment. Never starts an assessment or grants authority; dispatch rechecks applicability.

ComputeAvailability.description:
Resources available to the caller at routing time.

These values are optional because agents often know context-window or quota
headroom that the local process cannot detect.
ComputeAvailability.title: ComputeAvailability

QuotaState.title: QuotaState

tools.name: aeep_stack_propose
tools.description: Propose an inert compatible stack from semantic requirements only. No task payloads, execution, installation or authority changes.

tools.name: aeep_stack_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a stored immutable stack proposal.

tools.name: aeep_stack_optimize
tools.description: Create an inert successor using another configured policy.

tools.name: aeep_stack_preflight
tools.description: Recheck stack assumptions and report setup and approval blockers. Grants no authority.
